main_text.p: כְּלִיל masc. Perfectum, Absolutum, Totum, Integrum, Consummatum, Consummatio: Et adverbialiter Absolutè, Integrè, Penitùs, Prorsus, In universum, Universaliter: Item, Holocaustum, Sacrificium totum consumendum igne, ut Deuteronom.33.10. Interdum cum עוֹלָה, quòd proprie Holocaustum significat, conjungitur, ut Psal.51.21. ubi Aben Esra notat, עוֹלָה fuisse Sacrificium juge, כְּלִיל Sacrificium Sacerdotis, de qua Levit.6.16. al.23. Constr. עֲלַת כְּלִיל הָעִיר Ascendit consummatio urbis ad cœlum, Jud.20.40. id est, Totali incendio urbs consumpta fuit: וּכְלִיל יְפִי Et perfectus pulchritudine, Ezech.28.12. Fœmin. Constr. כְּלִילַת יְפִי Perfecta pulchritudine, Thren.2.15.

כַּלָּה f. Sponsa, respectu sponsi: Nurus, respectu soceri vel socrus, sic dicta, quòd priorem vitæ statum, sive virginitatis sive viduitatis, tunc cum fit sponsa vel uxor alterius, Perficiat & absolvat: vel ut Kimchi in lib. Rad. scribit, à Perfecto ornatu. Tunc enim omnia sua ornamenta producit, & ornat se perfectissimè: כַּכַּלָּה Sicut sponsa, Jesa.49. v.17. Aff. כַּלָּתוֹ Nurum suam, Gen.11.31. Plur. cum Aff. וּכְלוֹתֵיכֶם Et sponsas vestras, Hos.4.13. לִשְׁתֵּי כַּלּוֹתֶיהָ Ambabus nuribus suis, Ruth.1.8.
כְּלוּלוֹת f. Sponsalia: Aff. כְּלוּלֹתֶיךָ Sponsaliorum tuorum, Jerem.2.2.

כֹּל Omnis, Omne, Totum, Universum: Omnes, Omnia, si plurali adjungatur. Cum negandi particula, בְּלִתִּי, לֹא אַיִן est, Quicquam, Ullum: Nullum, Nihil quicquam: ut, וּלְרֵאשׁ אֵין כֹּל Pauperi autem nihil quicquam erat, 2.Sam.12.3. לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ כָל מְלָאכָה Non facies omne opus, id est, ullum, Exod.20.10. Aff. כֻּלָּהּ Totus ipse, Jerem.8.10. כֻּלָּהּ Tota ipsa, Mal.3.9. כֻּלָּם Universi ipsi, 1.Reg.22.v.28. quod & irregulariter כלהם

page.notes: Hebrew and niqqud transcribed from the scan; the vowel points and some word forms in the entries (notably the Aff. forms and the bracketed lines of the כְּלִיל and כַּלָּה entries) are doubtful at this resolution and should be checked against the original. The final word כלהם is printed right-aligned on its own line, continuing the last entry. No catchword or signature visible.
